contexts.text: A tree of knowledge seen with a great viper in it. SE 3993.
The most deceitful appear as vipers. CL 514:3.
The sucking child shall play on the hole of the viper ()... Vipers = those who are most deceitful. AE 314:3. AE 410:9. AE 581:5.
Falsity lies hidden in the truths they speak, and evil in the goods they do hence they are called an offspring of vipers (). AE 581:5.
Genii scatter evils round as vipers do poison.
When they are inspected as to their deceit and cunning, they appear like vipers.
The deceitful are signified in the Word by ... vipers; and the deceit by their poison.
The ankles of (the devil's) feet were like two vipers.
Like vipers hidden in a rock full of holes.
In the Hell of assassins and poisoners, there appear... lower down, as it were dragons and vipers, because they flatter before they infuse their poison.
(The cunning and deceitful) are sensuous, and are serpents, but especially poisonous ones, and vipers; and so do they appear in the light of Heaven.
(That bishop) afterwards appeared like a viper.
The hole of the viper = the Hells in which are deceitful and cunning Spirits, the entrances to which appear like dusky holes.
The viper, and flying fire-serpent () = what is sensuous reasoning cunningly and craftily.
